survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This OECD country note is descriptive and does not present a student-level ILSA micro-data analysis with an explicit sampling/replicate-weighting scheme. The document reports system-level indicators (e.g., educational attainment, NEET rates, completion rates, expenditure per student, teacher salary ratios) drawn from Education at a Glance 2025 tables, rather than estimating model-based effects from a complex survey sample. As a result, there is no stated application of student/sampling weights (e.g., W_FSTUWT) or replicate weights (e.g., BRR/jackknife) in the note itself. For users who access the underlying OECD indicator datasets, weighting and variance estimation would follow the methodological documentation for each indicator in Education at a Glance 2025: Sources, Methodologies and Technical Notes.

data.handling_not_reported_explanation: This document is a country note summarizing education-system indicators rather than an empirical analysis predicting student outcomes from ILSA cognitive achievement scores. Plausible Values (PV) are therefore not applicable because the note does not model PV-based achievement; it reports descriptive statistics and cross-indicator comparisons. Missing-data handling is not reported because no micro-data estimation procedure (e.g., PV estimation, imputation, or deletion rules) is described in the note; instead, the OECD indicator production process is documented in the accompanying Sources, Methodologies and Technical Notes.

sample_details.sample_filtering_criteria: Used the latest available Education at a Glance 2025 indicator data for Romania; the note does not specify an analytic subsample or student-level inclusion/exclusion criteria.

data.outcome_summary: This OECD Education at a Glance 2025 country note for Romania provides descriptive system-level indicators across educational attainment, labour-market outcomes, participation, progression in tertiary education, education financing, and teacher and instruction-time characteristics. It reports trends over time (e.g., below upper secondary attainment from 2019 to 2024; NEET shares for 18–24 year-olds; unemployment rates by attainment) and compares Romania to OECD averages. The note also summarizes tertiary completion within theoretical and extended durations, field-of-study composition, bachelor’s dropout after the first year, and international student mobility. Because it is not an ILSA micro-data study, it does not specify PV generation/combination, missing-data procedures, or ML model evaluation; instead, it points readers to the Education at a Glance 2025 tables and the Sources, Methodologies and Technical Notes for indicator definitions and methodological details.
data.null_fields_interpretation: This extraction corresponds to a descriptive OECD country note rather than an empirical large-scale assessment analysis with a defined student sample, PV-based outcomes, or ML modeling. Consequently, fields related to ML techniques, PV handling, missing-data handling, and main predictive findings are structurally empty by design. The note’s methodological content is primarily documentation pointers to the underlying indicator tables and technical notes, not a standalone statistical modeling workflow.
